body.purpose: Default 13px UI chrome — sidebar, tabs, menus, forms.

title.purpose: Dialog titles and panel headers; the largest type in the app.

mono.purpose: SQL, data values, identifiers — mono means data.

shadows.name: hairline
shadows.purpose: Resting separation for panels and insets.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Dialogs over a dimmed blurred overlay.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single accent action in a view — confirm, run, connect.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--ds-accent, #2563eb); color: var(--ds-text-inverse, #fff); padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 6px); cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1), opacity 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--ds-accent-hover, #1d4ed8); } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 0.8; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ds-accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet neutral action — cancel, secondary operations.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--ds-control-bg, #f3f1ef); color: var(--ds-label, #1b1b1f); padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; border: 1px solid var(--ds-separator, #d4d2ce); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 6px); cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #f0efed); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: var(--surface-pressed, #e4e2df); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ds-accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Irreversible actions — drop, delete rows, disconnect.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { background: var(--ds-destructive, #dc2626); color: var(--ds-text-inverse, #fff); padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-control, 6px); cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-destructive:active { opacity: 0.8; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form field — connection settings, filters, search.
components.css: .ds-input { background: var(--ds-control-bg, #f3f1ef); color: var(--ds-label, #1b1b1f); border: 1px solid var(--ds-separator, #d4d2ce); border-radius: var(--radius-control, 6px); padding: 6px 10px; font-size: 13px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--ds-tertiary, #9ca3af); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ds-accent, #2563eb); }

components.name: Enum Chip
components.description: Tinted value badge — the 12%/28%/full tint formula, cycling 8 data-enum hues.
components.css: .ds-chip { --chip-color: var(--ds-syntax-enum, #ea580c); display: inline-block; padding: 1px 6px; font-size: 11px; font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; border-radius: var(--radius-badge, 4px); color: var(--chip-color); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--chip-color) 12%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--chip-color) 28%, transparent); }

components.name: Schema Tree Row
components.description: One row of the sidebar object explorer; icon colored by object kind.
components.html: users
components.css: .ds-tree-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 3px 8px; font-size: 13px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', sans-serif; color: var(--ds-label, #1b1b1f); background: var(--ds-sidebar-bg, #f5f5f7); border-radius: var(--radius-badge, 4px); cursor: default; transition: background 100ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); } .ds-tree-row:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #f0efed); } .ds-tree-icon { color: var(--schema-table, #15803d); flex: none; }

components.name: Data Grid Cell Row
components.description: Signature surface: dense mono values colored by data type.
components.css: .ds-grid-row { display: flex; gap: 16px; padding: 3px 10px; font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; background: var(--ds-content-bg, #fff); border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ds-separator, #d4d2ce) 55%, transparent); } .ds-grid-row:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #f0efed); } .ds-cell-num { color: var(--data-number, #0891b2); } .ds-cell-text { color: var(--data-text, #1b1b1f); } .ds-cell-bool { color: var(--data-boolean-true, #16a34a); } .ds-cell-null { color: var(--data-null, #9ca3af); font-style: italic; }

narrative.overview: Esploro is a craftsman's bench for databases: everything within reach, dense, nothing ornamental. The interface is built so the data — grids, schema trees, query results — carries the visual weight, while chrome recedes into flat, hairline-separated surfaces. It reads as a native macOS tool (SF Pro at 13px, system materials, light/dark parity), not a web app that happens to run in a window. The system is two-layered: a palette layer (--ds-* tokens) defines the raw colors per theme, and a semantic craft contract maps them to roles. Components consume only the semantic layer — this is what makes eleven palettes work without touching a component.
keyCharacteristics: Professional-tool density: 13px UI type, 12px mono data, compact rows
Flat surfaces separated by hairlines; shadows strictly mean "floats above the workspace"
Restrained color: blue accent for actions/selection/focus only; the rich color lives in data
Theme-agnostic components via the semantic token contract

rules.name: The Contract Rule
rules.body: Components never reference --ds-* palette tokens or raw hex. They consume the semantic layer only. Breaking this breaks all eleven themes at once.

rules.name: The Data-Owns-Color Rule
rules.body: Chrome is neutral. Saturation belongs to meaning: syntax highlighting, type badges, enum chips, state indicators. If a decorative element wants color, the answer is no.

rules.name: The Tint Formula
rules.body: Colored chips/badges are built from their hue via color-mix: 12% background tint, 28% border tint, full-strength text. Never solid colored fills for passive labels.

rules.name: The One-Notch Rule
rules.body: Adjacent hierarchy levels differ by one step (12 → 13 → 14px) and/or one weight grade. No jumps, no display sizes.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Data Rule
rules.body: Monospace marks database content (SQL, values, identifiers, types). UI chrome is never mono; data is never proportional.

rules.name: The Floats-Above Rule
rules.body: Shadows appear only on transient layers (popover, modal) and the active-pane ring. A resting panel with a drop shadow is a bug.

dos: Do route every color through the semantic contract (--surface-*, --text-*, --state-*, --data-*); this is what keeps all eleven palettes working.
Do keep controls compact and quiet: 6px radius, px-3 py-1.5, 12px medium labels, accent only on the primary action.
Do use the tint formula (12% bg / 28% border / full text) for any colored chip or badge.
Do use the motion tokens (100/150/220ms, standard/enter/exit eases) and respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Do keep light/dark parity for every new surface — test both, plus at least one optional palette.
donts: Don't look like pgAdmin or DBeaver: no toolbar sprawl, no dialog mazes, no chrome competing with data.
Don't import generic SaaS web-app styling: no cards with decorative shadows, no marketing gradients, no hero metrics inside a desktop tool.
Don't hardcode hex values or reach past the contract into --ds-* tokens from components.
Don't put a drop shadow on a resting surface — shadows mean "floats above the workspace."
Don't use accent fills for selection in data surfaces; selection is --surface-selected so type-colored values stay legible.
Don't use proportional type for data or mono for chrome.
Don't remove the global focus-visible ring without an equal-or-better replacement.
